newsitem.title: GREECE: Strike shuts down Acropolis to visitors.
newsitem.headline: Strike shuts down Acropolis to visitors.

text.p: The Athens Acropolis, Greece's most visited monument, will be closed to tourists this week because of a pay strike by Culture Ministry employees.
Visitors who walk up the steep hill to the entrance to the Classical monuments find a sign reading: "The Acropolis is closed due to a strike by Culture Ministry employees".
The Panhellenic Federation of Culture Ministry Unions (OSYPA) has been on an indefinite strike since Monday to press for pay rises and bigger bonuses, it said in a statement.
The union also shut down attractions in the northern Greek city of Salonika -- the Archaeological Museum, the Byzantine Museum and the White Tower.
